_rationale: Verifies inflation indexing of federal brackets and standard deduction. Single filer, Traditional-only, Florida (0% state), 80k/yr spending (fixed), 0% return, 3% inflation. Index 0 (2026, age 60): factor=1.0, no senior deduction, deduction=$16,100. Tax ≈ $11,244 (22% bracket). Index 10 (2036, age 70): factor=1.03^10≈1.3439; inflated std deduction=$21,637, inflated senior deduction=$2,755, total=$24,392; inflated 12%-bracket top=$67,733. Tax ≈ $7,204 (all in 12% bracket). Without inflation indexing the same year would produce ~$10,665 tax — the 33% reduction confirms indexing is active.
